market.what: gas-treating amines (MEA, MDEA, blends) for gas sweetening and CO2 capture, world
market.method: avg of 3 reports: FMI $3.23B (2024), GII $3.3B (2024), GMI $3.19B (2023); MDEA alone $754M. CCS solvent make-up is only ~$3/t CO2 (1.75 kg/t x $1,700/t MEA)
market.job_what: solvents sold for CO2 capture (post-combustion and industrial capture), world
market.job_method: avg Fact.MR $444M & GMI $400M (2025); bottom-up make-up only ~50 Mt/yr captured x ~$3/t = ~$0.15B, rest is first fills; med-low confidence

value.logic: MEA 3.7 GJ/t, KS-type ~3.0, target ~2.3. Save 0.7 GJ/t x ~$7/GJ steam (est.) = $5/t + $2/t less degradation/reclaiming = $7/t x est. 110 Mt/yr post-combustion amine capture by 2030 (64 Mtpa op 2025 x5, ~35% post-combustion) = $770M
value.revenue_logic: license via EPC/technology partner: ~$1.5/t royalty x 8 Mt/yr captured with K14 solvent + solvent supply margin (est.)
value.margin_logic: mostly license royalty; solvent made by partner

trend.drivers: CCS capture capacity 5x 2025->2030 (GCCSI); 45Q $85/t point source; EU/UK/Norway CCS clusters; gas-treating amines ~5.7%/yr

competition.paper_query: amine CO2 capture solvent regeneration energy degradation
competition.notes: Licensors own the market; new solvents need long pilots. ION Clean Energy (founded 2008) raised $45M led by Chevron in 2024.

lab.synth: catalog or 1-2 step custom amines (hindered/diamine blends), 3 variants
lab.test: CO2 cyclic capacity 40/120 C (VLE screening), heat of absorption by calorimetry, oxidative (O2+Fe, 55-70 C) and thermal (135-150 C, sealed) degradation with LC-MS; e.g. UT Austin, NTNU/SINTEF
lab.logic: synth 6 wk + tests 8 wk; 3 x $6k synth + ~$27k screening and degradation runs

sale.gates: mini-pilot then 6-12 month pilot at NCCC or TCM Mongstad; emissions/nitrosamine permit; licensor or EPC adoption into FEED
